source_snapshot.test_name: FIO Mix read/write bandwidth/IOPS (70/30% read/write @ QD1, bs=512B, numjobs=1)
source_snapshot.purpose_facts: Title requests mixed random 70% read/30% write at QD1, 512B and one job.
procedure_facts: Actual job uses `rw=randwrite` with no `rwmixread`, so it is 100% random write.
Job requests 43200 seconds but Machine Time is 60 minutes.
No filename, size or offset bounds the destructive target; `./fio` is unverified.
criteria_facts: fio result matches an unspecified specification.
source_conflicts: Title 70/30 mixed random I/O conflicts with 100% randwrite job.
missing_source_information: Persistent empty SSD target/range, block alignment and raw/file scope.

original_test_intent.statement: Measure a 70% read/30% write random SSD workload at 512B, one job and effective QD1 over a signed sacrificial range, but do not execute until the randwrite and 43200s/60min source conflicts are formally resolved.
must_preserve: 70/30 mixed random intent from title, 512B, one job and QD1.
Destructive write risk and complete fio/health evidence.
must_not_infer: That `direct=1` disables device cache or 512B is aligned.

v2_review_conclusion.summary: V2 correctly detects randwrite versus 70/30, missing rwmixread/target/range and 12-hour destructive risk.
v2_review_conclusion.specific_gap: V2 does not also elevate 43200 seconds versus Machine Time 60, verify 512-byte direct-I/O alignment, or require measured read/write mix, media/preconditioning/steady-state and endurance evidence.

related_records: Other fio cases cannot resolve this row's mixed-ratio and duration conflicts.
applicable_history.precedence_application: Items and Procedure conflict; V3 must not silently rewrite the job or run either interpretation.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: No writes until formal revision selects 70/30 versus randwrite and 12 hours versus 60 minutes, then binds a sacrificial aligned range, media profile, thresholds, endurance and recovery.

conditions_present: Title supplies mixed ratio/QD/block/job; procedure supplies fio engine/random options/ramp.
missing: Authoritative workload/duration, target/range/alignment, exact binary, media state, thresholds, endurance and recovery.
provider: Storage owner assigns sacrificial range and accepts data loss/endurance.
safe_read_only_work: Inventory persistent SSD identity/topology, block sizes, mounts/LVM/RAID/swap, fio version and SMART/NVMe health; parse proposed job without I/O.
prohibited_until_resolved: Install, unmount/format/trim/precondition, write, clear logs or PASS.
closure_evidence: Two-view target exclusion and 512B alignment proof.

revision_candidate.test_name: Measure QD1 512-Byte 70/30 Random Mixed I/O on an SSD
revision_candidate.purpose: After formal source correction, measure sustained 70% random reads and 30% random writes with 512-byte blocks, one job and effective QD1 on one bounded empty SSD range, and compare stable read/write IOPS, bandwidth and latency plus post-test health with a profile-matched specification. Until correction, record SOURCE_CONFLICT execution readiness; do not reclassify the technically automatable case as automation BLOCKED.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: Exact SSD/namespace/controller/firmware, OS/kernel/fio/libaio, raw-or-file scope, cache/preconditioning and filesystem state. This candidate follows the title's 70/30 intent only after signed correction; it is not authority to overwrite the source.
revision_candidate.target_scope: One persistent empty sacrificial SSD range with exact offset/size; `rw=randrw`, `rwmixread=70`, bs=512B, numjobs=1, direct=1, effective iodepth=1 and signed ramp/runtime. The source 43200s/60min conflict must be closed before execution.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Formal corrected job/duration; target identity/range/exclusion; 512B alignment; fio hash/version; random seed/distribution; preconditioning/cache/steady-state; numeric read/write IOPS/BW/latency/mix criteria; endurance/thermal limits; destructive approval and restore.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Capture identity, alignment, health and exact job; parse-only before I/O. After separate media-preparation and destructive gates, run the corrected bounded fio job and record achieved depth, measured read/write byte/IO mix, stable-window metrics, host/device writes, health/temperature and full logs. Never execute the current randwrite file as the mixed test.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Conflicts formally resolved; target empty/excluded; alignment valid; media/profile/spec frozen; approvals/monitoring/recovery ready.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Correction decision; target/topology/alignment proof; fio/job hashes; media/cache/preconditioning state; complete runtime; achieved QD1 and 70/30 mix; separate read/write IOPS/BW/latency percentiles; bytes written/endurance/temperature; before/after health/logs; restoration.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: Signed SSD spec for the corrected 70/30 QD1 512B profile and duration. Pass requires measured mix and stable metrics within limits, zero disallowed errors and acceptable health/endurance; 100% randwrite or a shortened run is invalid.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Do not choose a target, write boot/data/RAID/LVM/swap, broaden range, issue misaligned I/O, silently replace randwrite, shorten duration, change media/cache, clear logs, auto-retry or claim PASS.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: Test owner signs correction; storage owner signs target/data loss/endurance/restore; performance/lab owners sign profile/limits; human authorizes immediately before I/O and judges result.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Humans resolve source conflicts and select target. Agent inventories and runs only the frozen corrected job after gates.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: On wrong target/mix/range, media error or limit, stop safely, freeze writes, preserve evidence and use only approved reset/reprovision; fresh approval before rerun.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Any source conflict, target/range/alignment/profile/spec/approval/recovery missing; measured mix drifts; out-of-range I/O, media/controller error, thermal/endurance breach, device loss, host instability or monitoring loss.

reason_for_change: Prevent a destructive 100%-write run from masquerading as the requested mixed profile and make duration/target/media gates explicit.

new_technical_evidence.title: fio HOWTO
new_technical_evidence.supports: `randrw` and `rwmixread` define mixed random ratio; filename/size bound targets; time_based/runtime and achieved depth require verification.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: Exact installed behavior and device alignment are platform-specific.

new_technical_evidence.supports: 70/30 title, randwrite job, 43200 seconds and 20/60 metadata.

removed_ambiguities: Requires achieved ratio, alignment and bounded target.
remaining_blockers: Formal workload/duration correction and destructive handoff required.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 prevents the 100%-write script from satisfying a 70/30 test, adds measured-mix and 512-byte alignment proof, and preserves the unresolved twelve-hour versus one-hour decision as a release gate.

agent_understanding_result.notes: First contract-only validation preserved the technical boundaries but described current execution as blocked, risking confusion with automation classification. After the contract explicitly distinguished SOURCE_CONFLICT readiness from REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION capability, revalidation was CLEAR: the validator preserved 70/30 versus randwrite and 43200s versus 60min conflicts, bounded target, alignment, achieved QD1/mix, media/endurance gates and no-I/O status. This is not independent-model or DUT validation.
